name: Scale
question: How fast can we take the mass market?

gate.name: Market leadership with healthy margins
asks: Is the venture taking the mass market faster than its rivals?
Do margins hold as it grows?
Do operations hold quality at volume?

evidence.statement: A money summary showing revenue and margin over time
A budget the venture runs to
An operations readiness record for volume

weights.note: Unvalidated priors, ours: how much each function's open decisions count when decisions are ranked across functions in this phase. They sum to 1. The decision queue ranks with them (packages/naive/src/engine/decision-queue.ts, EE-127).

strategy.why: The direction is set; strategy reviews it on a cadence

marketing-and-sales.why: Taking share while the market forms

service-delivery.why: Delivery at volume without losing quality

it.why: Systems and access at a size that needs control

finance.why: Margins, cash and the cost of growth

assets.why: Owned and leased assets start to accumulate

external-relationships.why: Funding for growth, mostly arranged before

capabilities.why: Processes and postmortems keep quality as the team grows
